description: Conventional thresholds for illustration and comparison. They are policy choices, not regulatory thresholds: the ECB 2019 IRB validation-reporting instructions set no pass or fail thresholds, and each entry names where its convention comes from. Institutions replace this file with their own policy.

pd.jeffreys.source: convention: 5% and 1% significance levels; the ECB (2019) instructions and BCBS WP14 set no thresholds

pd.binomial.source: convention: 5% and 1% significance levels; the ECB (2019) instructions and BCBS WP14 set no thresholds

pd.chi2_grades.source: convention: 5% and 1% significance levels; the ECB (2019) instructions and BCBS WP14 set no thresholds

pd.default_profile.source: convention: 5% and 1% significance levels; Tasche (2013) reads the 2009 fit (p 9%) as rejectable at 10%, and the ECB (2019) instructions and BCBS WP14 set no thresholds

pd.hosmer_lemeshow.source: convention: 5% and 1% significance levels; the ECB (2019) instructions and BCBS WP14 set no thresholds

pd.spiegelhalter.source: convention: 5% and 1% significance levels; the ECB (2019) instructions and BCBS WP14 set no thresholds

pd.normal_multiperiod.source: convention: 5% and 1% significance levels; the ECB (2019) instructions and BCBS WP14 set no thresholds

pd.traffic_lights.source: convention: 5% and 1% on P(V <= v); BCBS WP14 defines v_alpha for a chosen confidence level

stability.psi.source: Yurdakul and Naranjo (2020) chi-square benchmark at 5% and 1%; the 0.10/0.25 bands are reported beside it as a rule of thumb without error control

rating.momentum.source: convention: 5% and 1% significance levels; no supervisory text sets thresholds for these tests

fair.demographic_parity.source: convention: the amber tolerance 0.05 on the largest absolute selection-rate gap is proposed, no dossier value; strict (a gap equal to the tolerance is green); red 2.0 is a sentinel above the metric's range: never red

fair.two_proportion_z.source: convention: the engine's default p-value cut points (5% and 1%); dossier 06 C.7 l.1036-1039

fair.fisher_exact.source: convention: the engine's default p-value cut points (5% and 1%); dossier 06 C.7 l.1036-1039

fair.equalized_odds.source: convention: proposed for the Taiwan battery, no dossier value (06 C.7 l.1029-1033)

fair.equal_opportunity.source: convention: proposed for the Taiwan battery, no dossier value (06 C.7 l.1029-1033)

fair.calibration_within_groups.source: convention: proposed for the Taiwan battery, no dossier value (04 J.3 l.904-905)

fair.auc_by_group.source: convention: proposed for the Taiwan battery, no dossier value (04 J.3 l.904-905)

fair.situation_testing.source: convention: the amber share 0.20 of significant complainants, set on the measured size 0.039 and power 1.000 at n 400 and k 30 (docs/fairness/06), no source value; red 2.0 is a sentinel above the metric's range: never red

ml.robustness.source: AUC degradation at the preset scale: amber above perturbation_tolerance (0.02), red above twice it, a delta equal to the tolerance green; convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.shift_resilience.source: Monte Carlo p-value of the AUC drop on the worst subsample by shift score against the drop of random development subsets of the evaluation size (06 C.7 l.1013-1015 gives the construction only): the engine default p-value cut points (alpha_amber 0.05, alpha_red 0.01); convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.seed_stability.source: standard deviation of the AUC across seeds: proposed, about the sampling standard error of a Taiwan holdout AUC (0.008); convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.reason_code_stability.source: mean top-four reason overlap across refits: proposed, no dossier value (04 J.2 l.881-883); convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.effect_agreement.source: Spearman rho of mean absolute SHAP against the range of the ALE curve: proposed, no dossier value (06 C.7 l.1006-1008); convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.additivity.source: maximum Shapley additivity gap: red above the numeric tolerance (1e-09); convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.overfit.source: train minus holdout AUC gap: red above overfit_tolerance (0.05); convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.weak_spot.source: error ratio of the worst slice to the average error: amber above weak_spot_multiple (2.0); red 1e12 is a sentinel no ratio reaches, so never red; convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.conformal_coverage.source: Beta-Binomial p-value of the coverage against 1 - alpha given the calibration size: the engine default p-value cut points (alpha_amber 0.05, alpha_red 0.01); convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.leakage_screen.single_feature_auc.source: largest single-feature max(AUC, 1 - AUC): near-perfect above 0.95, no dossier value; convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.leakage_screen.resemblance_auc.source: cross-fitted development against out-of-time AUC: proposed, no dossier value; convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.leakage_screen.temporal_order.source: feature values dated after the observation date: one is a leak by definition (06 C.7 l.1048-1051); rule, not a convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.leakage_screen.entity_overlap.source: any test entity present in training (the indicator 1 when the overlap share is above 0): a leak by definition; rule, not a convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

ml.data_quality.source: largest share of failed checks over the dq_ counts: proposed, no dossier value (06 C.7 l.1045-1047); convention (engine-ml-api 2.0.0, Policy thresholds)

gov.inventory_completeness.source: convention: amber below 0.9 and red below 0.7 of the (entry, attribute) pairs with a status other than missing; no source prescribes a completeness level (dossier 06 B.2 l.539-551, item 30 of the UNVERIFIED list); strict (a share equal to the cut is not below it)

gov.findings_overdue.source: convention: amber above 0 and red above 0.25 of the open-state findings past their due date; no source prescribes days or a tolerance (dossier 06 B.7, item 30); strict (a share equal to the cut is not above it)

gov.validation_due.source: convention: amber at 1 and red at 2 or more entries past their next review date (dossier 06 B.8 l.630-640, item 30)

gov.tier_override_documented.source: convention: red at 1 or more tier overrides without a rationale or an approver; there is no amber (dossier 06 B.3 l.574-575, SS1/23 Principle 1.3(d)(e)); amber equals red

gov.edges_acyclic.source: convention: red at 1 or more entries on a cycle or edges to an unknown entry; there is no amber (dossier 06 I.2); amber equals red
